_source: Derived from sheets 'CRITICAL NON CRITICAL COMPONENT' and 'COMMON CHINESE' of Chinese_Components_FINAL.xlsx

Flight Controller.note: Controls the air vehicle, flight path and Tx/Rx of data. Mostly CubePilot variants (Australia) with Taiwan-sourced parts; indigenous FCUs also available.

On Board Computer.note: Mostly NVIDIA Jetson variants of US origin, but WiFi module and DRAM/storage often of Chinese origin.

CRPA.note: STM32F4 microcontrollers found to be of Chinese origin.

GNSS Receiver.note: STM32G4A1KEU6 class ICs found to be of Chinese origin.

RTK GNSS Receiver.note: Alternate/backup for main GPS receiver; Chinese-origin chips found in some units.

Radio Modem.policy: Chinese origin not acceptable except passive components not in the Tx/Rx chain
Radio Modem.note: A/D converters and passive ICs in GDT/radio modems found to be of Chinese origin.

GCS.policy: Chinese origin NOT acceptable. GETAC (Taiwan) and Panasonic (Japan) acceptable
GCS.note: Used for control, mission data upload and mission detail download.

Antenna.note: No smart components. Omni/directional antennae in GDT may contain Chinese parts.

Motor.note: BLDC motors; some Indian manufacture, some Chinese origin.

ESC.note: Some ESCs (e.g. Vertiq USA) contain STM32-series microcontrollers of Chinese-origin manufacture. Chipset cannot Tx/Rx data and embedded code cannot be remotely altered.

Battery.note: Li-ion/Li-po/dry solid; cells manufactured in China.

Power Distribution Board.note: DC-DC converters found to contain Chinese components.

Payload.note: Certain image processors and encoders of Chinese origin.

Ethernet Switch.policy: Chinese origin not acceptable in Tx/Rx chain
Ethernet Switch.note: Controller ICs found to be Shenzhen-sourced.
